newsitem.title: USA: Cocaine washes ashore in south Florida.
newsitem.headline: Cocaine washes ashore in south Florida.

text.p: Five bales of cocaine with a total street value of $2.5 million were found by an oceanfront condominium worker after they washed ashore on a Fort Lauderdale beach, the U.S. Customs Service said on Wednesday.
Helicopters and Coast Guard vessels were sent to pick up the haul and search for more bales.
Customs agents said the bales, containing a total of 330 pounds (150 kg), could have been lost in an air drop or during a ship to ship transfer.
More than 17,000 pounds (7,760 kg) of illegal drugs washed ashore in south Florida in 1996, according to Customs figures.
